generate_python_from_proto: run the generate_py_protobufs distutils command to compile .proto files into Python source modules
configure_proto_source_dir: set the source_dir option to specify which directory contains .proto files for code generation
add_extra_proto_paths: pass extra_proto_paths to resolve import statements in .proto files from additional directories
set_custom_protoc_path: configure the protoc option to use a specific protoc compiler binary path instead of PATH lookup
review_generate_py_protobufs_class: review the generate_py_protobufs class to understand how finalize_options computes proto_root_path to avoid duplicate definition errors
